_note: ENGINE DATA for social-copy: the gate model and the organic post formats. Counts live here and nowhere else; prose never restates them. A brand's recurring series (a weekly carousel, a monthly story set) and its own masters are brand data: they live in its pack (type_registry_overlay, asset_types, slotmap_social) and never come back into this file.

angle.title: Angle
angle.help: Three framings of the post. A human picks the lens; every line below inherits it.
angle.note: Under a pre-selected route the gate still runs inside the route's frame: the same count, every option on the route's axis, the options differing on scene or mechanism (declared as `scene`). A series post still gets three angles on its subject.

cover.title: Cover line
cover.help: Three lines the post leads with: a feed post's on-image line, a carousel's cover, a story set's first frame. Hooks by position.
cover.note: A feed post with no text on the image skips this gate by declaring `on_image: false` on the slate.

caption.title: Caption
caption.help: Three whole captions as they will be posted, each with a different first line: what shows before the fold.
caption.note: Story sets carry no caption. The three differ in their first line, not in punctuation.

sequence.title: Panels or frames
sequence.help: The copy for every panel or frame of the picked angle and cover, in order.
sequence.note: Written once, on the human's pick. A carousel runs cover, inner panels, end; a story set runs frames, each one structure.

hook_rule: Cover hooks are assigned by position (A Problem, B Curiosity gap, C Direct address) so the three are a spread, not three phrasings of one line.
